verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Elements lets you "build a fully customized payment page," and that the Checkout payment page can be "embedded on your site" as an alternative to redirecting to a Stripe-hosted page. Its low-risk integrations also send card data straight to Stripe rather than through your servers. The evidence is brief, one-line doc mentions with no detail on how customization works, so the core story is delivered but thinly documented. Missing for 10: specifics of component customization (styling/appearance options, component types), evidence of in-app/mobile embedding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
